BHP said it would cut 1,200 jobs at its Nickel West operations and write down the division by US$2.1 billion, citing a slump in nickel prices and a slower Chinese property market.
South32 reported record quarterly manganese output and lifted full-year production guidance by 8%, saying prices had stabilised and it expects to return additional capital to shareholders.
Woodside said its quarterly production fell 4% after an unplanned outage at the Pluto LNG train, and left full-year guidance unchanged.
The Australian Prudential Regulation Authority said it had no concerns about the capital position of the major banks following its annual stress test.
Qantas said it would buy 12 additional narrowbody aircraft for delivery from 2028, funded from operating cash flow, and reiterated its margin guidance.
